title: Custom generator pre-handler contract
summary: Prepared the manifest contract and planning utilities for a new generators/custom option before writing adapter handlers.
inputs: User added generators/custom as an option for custom builds and asked to generate any scripts needed before adapter handlers, then pause handlers for next conversation.
